A four-panel illustration showing the four marketing utilities. Panel 1 (Place Utility): A truck carrying baskets of tomatoes from a rural farm to a city market. Panel 2 (Time Utility): Large metal silos storing grains during a rainy season to be used later. Panel 3 (Form Utility): A machine processing fresh cassava tubers into dry garri flakes. Panel 4 (Possession Utility): A market trader exchanging a bunch of plantains for Naira notes with a customer.
